response.overview: Inspired by his father's death Junior embarks on composing the soundtrack to his life. After a two year exile, Junior comes home to bury his father, to bury his childhood and to bury the memories that drove him away. Upon his return he discovers that his absence has left his old world unaffected. Jason his childhood nemesis, his longtime love, Sarah and his history of abuse and anguish all remain as he left it ... unresolved.
response.title: Lolo's Child
